conclusion: Expanded grouped-data training improves evaluator metrics; auxiliary CP plus ranking has not shown a reliable tactical-blunder reduction over matched WDL. Node-local exploration improves coverage and avoids two teacher-reported mate losses on a separate small cohort, without a demonstrated overall playing-strength gain.

Old model versus new training is not a controlled data-size-only ablation.

Four opening pairs per arena; no reliable Elo or general strength ranking.
